name: (04) Protean — 3 Advanced — Restore the Mortal Visage

system.description: Spend two Blood Traits and a Willpower Trait, then win a Static Mental Challenge to make all of your accumulated animal features disappear for the rest of the scene, along with any Negative Social Traits they caused. Reputed to be safe only for Gangrel; rumor holds that Nosferatu who attempted it met swift, gruesome Final Death.
system.bloodCost: Two Blood Traits plus One Willpower Trait
